t: This is the Victoria Palace Theatre on Victoria Street in Westminster, a West End house that has been home to the musical Hamilton since 2017. Frank Matcham designed it in 1911, and it was the last London theatre he designed before retiring. It was a commission from the variety magnate Alfred Butt. The building has been Grade II* listed since 1972, so you're looking at the final London chapter of one of Britain's great theatre architects.
